title: Organiser v2 mobile nav
question: The floating burger sits outside the clubhouse. Which mobile pattern should replace it? Desktop sidebar stays.

options.label: Integrated top bar
options.thesis: A flush page shell holds logo, title, and menu — the trigger lives inside the layout, not as a floating orphan.
options.viewport: Thin sticky bar: SPORTSHUB mark + ORGANISER HUB + avatar/menu. Sheet slides from the bar; content starts under it with no dead pt-16.
options.risk: Steals vertical space from every mobile screen.

options.label: Bottom primary dock
options.thesis: Primary destinations sit in a calm bottom dock; deeper items open a sheet — navigation where the thumb already is.
options.viewport: Dock: Dashboard, Events, Forms, Gallery, More. More opens the full organiser menu (settings, help, profile). No top burger.
options.risk: Crowds the bottom of dense list screens; Events needs a clear expand path.

options.label: Avatar-led sheet
options.thesis: A quiet top identity chip opens the full nav sheet — header almost disappears until you need it.
options.viewport: Small avatar (or mark) flush in the top-left of the content plane; tap opens the same full sidebar sheet. No bordered burger tile.
options.risk: Discoverability if the chip looks like profile-only.
